title: Merging dynamic and static chirality in propeller-shaped carbazole oligomers via chiral amine substitution
content:

Yuma Tanioka, Ryosuke Omasa, Tetsuo Okujima, Hidemitsu Uno, Masayoshi Takase
Chiral propeller-shaped molecules bearing static chiral monoamine and diamine substituents were synthesized via two-step SNAr reactions and exhibited CD and CPL activity without optical resolution.
